question: How can Śiva's power be other-dependent in form yet not object-dependent?
premises: Śiva's power is eternally risen and unlimited.
It is other-dependent in form but not object-dependent.
inference: Therefore power is distinguished as an indestructible eternal attribute.
uncertainties: Exact sandhi and compound boundaries remain editorial.
plain_english: Śiva's power is eternally risen, other-dependent in form but not object-dependent; indestructible and eternal, distinguished from transformation.
